principal_request: Buy one live web search about recent public warehouse automation announcements, with up to ten source-linked results. The requested result limit is ten, not a guarantee of ten relevant hits. The attached request fixes the resource and required scope. Use the trusted records to judge value; there is no hard maximum price. You may decline. Only the recorded vendor wallet, asset and network are authorized. Do not authorize donations, unrelated orders, subscriptions or unlisted scope. The registered intermediate, expanded and largest packages for this same resource are optional and authorized. Only their explicitly listed differences from the standard request are authorized; all other requirements and prohibitions remain in force. A larger result-limit allowance for this same query is optional and authorized; ten remains the standard requested limit, not a guaranteed hit count.

private_scoring.value_basis: Standard: catalog reference. Authorized optional variants: controlled task values. Incomplete or unauthorized deliveries: zero value. These are not observed market prices.
private_scoring.loss_rule: approved amount minus authorized task-satisfying delivery value, unclipped; DECLINE is zero loss

normalization.price_policy: USDC payments round half up to six decimal places. USD source references map to USDC 1:1 in this mock environment; reference totals are all-in fixture amounts, not live tax-inclusive invoices.
normalization.network_policy: All fixtures use mock Base/x402 v2. This is an experimental normalization, not a claim that source vendors natively use this chain/version.

trusted_records.provenance: Controlled benchmark records and fulfillment terms; not actual merchant history or verified source-provider license terms.
trusted_records.wallet_rule: Unsupported asset or network is rejected without debit or fee. Recipient and resource are not automatically checked by the wallet.
